meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把目标拆解成步步有据的工作循环
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你面对复杂目标需要有条有理地推进
copy.tagline_en: Turn a goal into systematic, evidence-backed steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a complex goal and need a structured way to make progress.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在长任务中会先读取流程文档并正式登记目标,再把工作拆成一个个小步骤持续追踪;每个完成条件都必须有真实环境(终端、网页、文件等)的输出证据,测试通过不算完成。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-loop”、“ulw”等关键词,或要求做证据导向工作、手动 QA、带检查点的长线交付等任务时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop:先登记目标,再拆步骤逐步执行。
say.note: 它会按流程先登记好目标,再拆成小步骤执行。

say.text: 继续 ulw 任务,用证据驱动完成剩余部分。
say.note: 它会重读计划与目标,从当前状态继续。

say.text: 对这个需求跑 ulw-loop,每一步都给出真实证据。
say.note: 每步完成后会记录证据并标记为完成。

howto.what_en: Claude reads workflow docs, registers the goal, then splits work into small tracked steps. Each success criterion needs observable evidence from a real surface (terminal, browser, CLI, etc.); tests alone don't prove done.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'ulw-loop' or 'ulw', or asks for evidence-led work, manual QA, checkpointed long-running delivery, etc.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop: register the goal, then break it into steps and run.
say_en.note: It registers the goal and starts tracked execution.

say_en.text: Continue the ulw task and finish remaining steps with evidence.
say_en.note: It reloads the plan and current state, then resumes.

say_en.text: Run ulw-loop for this task and show real evidence at each step.
say_en.note: It records evidence per step before marking it done.
